correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed all 33 perfect matchings of the explicitly listed 16-vertex 24-edge GP(8,3) by lowest-uncovered-vertex recursion; each matching search branch is exhaustive. Enumerated complement triples to obtain precisely 20 unordered one-factorizations, then each bichromatic cycle switch to obtain 27 undirected distinct edges. The two components have (16 vertices,24 edges) and (4 vertices,3 edges); networkx isomorphism confirms the former is exactly GP(8,3), while the latter has degrees 3,1,1,1. The independent exhaustive enumerator is /mnt/data/mk_audit_check.py, not a partial sample. No claim about named 120-coloring graph.
